deploy: the Runtime's move, not the agent's
turn_output_budget: one turn has a bounded output budget, and a turn cut off by it fails the whole run: keep each tool call small (about 6000 characters / 150 lines at most), write a file over several calls instead of one, and keep the reasoning before a call brief
context_discovery: project knowledge is discovered only through context.list / context.search / context.get — planner and worker share that set; filesystem search defaults to this agent's own workspace only; do not grep outside it; a well-formed search with zero hits or a list with no documents is need_input (resource or information), do not ritual-retry and do not invent a grep capability
